title: Atlas Motion Systems | BLDC Motors and Actuators
excerpt: Atlas builds BLDC motors and actuators for defense and robotics — designed around your program, manufactured at scale.
content_html:
The physical layer of autonomy

Atlas builds motors for drones and robots, developed for your product and manufactured on our production lines as you scale.

Scroll down to explore

The right motor
for the mission.

Built to ramp with you

Autonomous platforms demand motion systems that can be designed precisely, prototyped quickly, and produced without adversarial supply-chain dependence.

00 01 02 03 04

— Our Process

NDAA-Compliant Motors

We design systems around your product requirement, starting from mission and capability-level goals.

We turn new motion system designs into real, testable hardware in weeks, not months.

We allocate manufacturing resources for our JDM partners and guarantee production capacity as customers scale.

We develop new motion system architectures for constrained environments where off-the-shelf systems cannot meet the requirement.

Integrate Integrate Evaluate Manufacture Innovate

The last era of technology digitized human knowledge and intelligence. The next takes that intelligence from bits and bytes and puts it to work in the physical world. Motion systems are the difference between a computer you sit at and a robot that acts on reality.

Read full Thesis ↗

The Atlas Ecosystem

  • We build in Southern California, birthplace of the American aerospace industry, with a team that built at Tesla, Shield AI, Anduril, Dyson, and MITRE. That foundation lets us deliver rapid-turn prototyping and production for programs with exacting compliance requirements.

  • Vector is our in-house design platform. It translates program requirements into a motion system design, simulates performance, and connects directly to prototyping and production. That integrated workflow takes a custom motion system from specification to first build in weeks, not months.

  • Volume production in the Philippines, America’s oldest treaty ally in Asia. A workforce with generational depth in precision manufacturing, building at the scale modern programs demand without compromising the supply chain.

Built to spec. Ready to scale.

content_html_zh:
物理层自治

Atlas 为无人机和机器人制造电机，为您的产品开发并根据您的规模在我们的生产线上制造。

向下滚动探索

适合执行任务的发动机。

专为与您一起坡道而打造

自主平台需要能够精确设计、快速原型化并且在不依赖供应链的情况下生产的运动系统。

00 01 02 03 04

— 我们的流程

符合 NDAA 的电机

我们从任务和能力级别目标出发，围绕您的产品需求设计系统。

我们在几周而不是几个月的时间内将新的运动系统设计转变为真实的、可测试的硬件。

我们为 JDM 合作伙伴分配制造资源，并根据客户规模保证生产能力。

我们为现成系统无法满足要求的受限环境开发新的运动系统架构。

整合 整合评估 制造创新

技术的最后一个时代将人类的知识和智能数字化。 接下来，我们将从比特和字节中获取智能，并将其应用到物理世界中。 运动系统是你坐在前面的计算机和在现实中行动的机器人之间的区别。

阅读全文 ↗

阿特拉斯生态系统

  • 我们在美国航空航天业的发源地南加州进行建设，团队成员曾来自 Tesla、Shield AI、Anduril、Dyson 和 MITRE。 这一基础使我们能够为具有严格合规性要求的项目提供快速原型设计和生产。
  • Vector 是我们的内部设计平台。 它将程序要求转化为运动系统设计，模拟性能，并直接连接到原型设计和生产。 该集成工作流程将定制运动系统从规范到首次构建只需数周而不是数月。
  • 在美国在亚洲最古老的条约盟友菲律宾进行批量生产。 一支在精密制造领域具有代际深度的员工队伍，在不影响供应链的情况下按照现代项目的需求规模进行建设。

按规格制造。 准备扩展。
